panels.description: Bua-ji holds the marked equipment fragment while Guddu compares its service number with a contractor copy from his permit folder. Keep upper-left clear.
Duda perches on a cement bag above the group, delivering his careful limitation. Keep the upper third open.
Moti stands beside the recovered dhurrie, one ear up, while the other four dogs guard the route behind him. Keep road and sky space clear.
Inside GODARAZ, Billi returns to the empty ball return opposite Duda’s lane-3 perch. She accepts no thanks. Keep the upper-left interior clear.

items.speaker: DUDA
items.text: I saw the goons take the galeecha. I did not hear the whole plan. I am a truthful bird.
